report_name: 'crpx0' Ransomware Gang Escalates to Data Sales After Failed Extortion

threat_actors.name: crpx0
threat_actors.description: An emerging ransomware group first observed in July 2026. The group uses social engineering with lures like fake OnlyFans promotions to distribute its ransomware. After initial extortion attempts failed against 47 victims, the group pivoted to selling the stolen data on newly created clear and dark web leak sites.
threat_actors.goals: Monetization of stolen data through extortion and direct sales.

attack_patterns.name: Spearphishing Link
attack_patterns.description: Used as the core initial access strategy, employing social engineering lures such as fake OnlyFans promotions to entice users to click malicious links.

attack_patterns.name: Web Protocols
attack_patterns.description: The crpx0 ransomware uses web protocols for data exfiltration prior to encryption.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The primary impact of the crpx0 ransomware payload is to encrypt victim files.

attack_patterns.name: Web Services
attack_patterns.description: The crpx0 group established their own web services in the form of data leak sites on both the clear and dark web to sell stolen data.

malware.name: crpx0 ransomware
malware.description: A ransomware payload used by the crpx0 group that performs data exfiltration before encrypting files. It is distributed through social engineering lures like fake OnlyFans accounts.

identities.name: OnlyFans
identities.description: The branding of OnlyFans was used as a social engineering lure by the crpx0 group in the form of fake accounts and promotions to distribute malware.

infrastructure.name: crpx0 Data Leak Site
infrastructure.description: Data leak sites created by the crpx0 group on both the clear and dark web to sell stolen data from victims who refused to pay the ransom.

indicators.name: Suspicious OnlyFans Themed URL
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious OnlyFans Themed URL Access
id: 27c8d9e0-f1a2-4b3c-8d9e-0f1a2b3c4d5e
status: experimental
description: Detects web traffic to URLs containing patterns associated with fake OnlyFans promotions, which have been used as lures by the crpx0 ransomware group.
references:
  - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pt-aG34-Gm0
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-17
tags:
  - attack.t1566.002
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate access to OnlyFans or related promotional material.
level: low
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    c-uri|contains:
      - 'onlyfans-promo'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects web traffic containing 'onlyfans-promo', a pattern associated with social engineering lures used by the crpx0 group.

indicators.name: Suspicious Promotional Installer Execution
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Promotional Installer Execution
id: 38d9e0f1-a2b3-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of a file named 'promo_installer.exe', which is a potential name for malware droppers used in social engineering campaigns like those by crpx0.
references:
  - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pt-aG34-Gm0
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-17
tags:
  - attack.t1204.002
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate installers with a similar generic name.
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\promo_installer.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of 'promo_installer.exe', a potential filename for malware distributed by the crpx0 group.
